mapper.select: SELECT todo_id, token, created_by, expires_at, created_at FROM task_shares WHERE todo_id = #{todoId} AND expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ORDER BY expires_at DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO task_shares (todo_id, token, created_by, expires_at) VALUES (#{todoId}, #{token}, #{createdBy}, #{expiresAt})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM task_shares WHERE expires_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
